experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Five years with SEGULA Technologies: from mechanical design to engineering leadership and European type approval.

items.role: European Type Approval Engineer (Stellantis-Toyota compact vans)
items.location: Tunis, Tunisia · remote with EU teams
details: Compile and steer European Community Whole Vehicle Type Approval (RCE) dossiers for multi-brand N1 programmes: Opel Combo, Peugeot Partner/Rifter, Citroën Berlingo and Toyota ProAce City.
Guarantee full compliance of each homologation dossier with EU regulatory requirements ahead of submission to the French approval authority (CNRV).
Conduct regulatory intelligence on evolving European automotive standards and directives, assessing their impact on vehicle conformity.
Audit and update the Fiche de Contrôle de Marquage (FCM) documentation governing approved markings across multiple models.
Liaise with OEM engineering teams and approval bodies (UTAC, CNRV) to drive validation, audits and final approval sign-off.
Administer homologation databases and prepare Demande W applications, securing provisional W-plate registrations that authorise road testing of pre-approval prototypes.

items.role: Engineering Leader - Braking System, Euro 7 (Renault Clio, Dacia Bigster, Dacia C-Neo)
items.location: Tunis, Tunisia · remote with EU teams
details: Directed validation-plan execution for the CMFB braking function within the PFC lot, aligning delivery with strategic validation goals and parts availability.

Devised component validation plans for critical braking elements (brake disc, Mastervac, ESP10, MKC2) and tracked System and Customer Performance validation across three concurrent vehicle programmes.
Safeguarded QCDP targets for the braking function: RTC and NRL milestone verifications, RTGFE alignment with the master schedule, and OneTD/SIGNE conformity at the RL2 gate.
Enabled critical decision-making by synthesising technical input and fostering cross-stakeholder collaboration.

items.role: PFE Support - Elementary Function Pilot, Steering System (new Renault Clio)
items.location: Tunis, Tunisia · remote with EU teams
details: Orchestrated multi-disciplinary activities (engineering, procurement, suppliers, logistics, manufacturing) covering the development, validation and industrialisation of steering components.
Administered key project deliverables - OneVAL progress, RGPQP milestones and LUP items - securing QCDP attainment for the steering function.

items.role: Engineering Leader - Front & Rear Axles / Wheel Assembly (new Renault Master, TGA to MA phases)
items.location: Tunis, Tunisia · remote with EU teams
details: Drove First Time Right (FTR) and On-Time Delivery (OTD) across a broad portfolio of technical deliverables: 2D/3D design dossiers, BOM/DEVO, IMDS, dimension chains, interface contracts, quality files (NRL, NDL, QDR, DDMRS-FMEA, RTC) and OneVAL validation plans.
Oversaw development and validation of critical chassis components: hub bearings (Gen2/Gen3), steering knuckles, discs, splash guards, rear axles, wheel carrier plates and associated fasteners.
Ensured product and process development conformed to industry standards, legal safety regulations and Renault Design System specifications, driving efficiency and quality optimisations.
Provided technical expertise to cross-functional teams (design, logistics, quality), strengthening design robustness and proactive risk management.

items.role: Mechanical Design Engineer - Smart Car (Citroën C3 & C3 Aircross)
details: Performed shape-plan analyses and feasibility studies for exterior plastic parts, applying injection-moulding design rules (minimum thickness, draft, part rigidity).
Designed and integrated components in CATIA V5: tail-lamp bracket, rear bumper upper and lower skins, skid plate, tow hook, sensor and side brackets, and lateral reinforcements.

about.title: About
about.tagline: A mechatronics engineer who takes vehicles from engineering deliverables to European approval.
about.body: I have spent five years in the automotive industry with SEGULA Technologies, working from Tunis for French OEM teams. I started in mechanical design on the Citroën C3, moved into engineering leadership of axles, steering and Euro 7 braking on Renault and Dacia programmes, and now steer European Community Whole Vehicle Type Approval for multi-brand Stellantis-Toyota compact vans. I hold a National Engineer Diploma in Mechatronics and work in Arabic, French and English.
